invariants.rule: Service Request and RFC internal identities remain stable across manual creation, official-source adoption, terminal state, archive, correction and relationship changes.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Adopt/enrich existing exact identities without replacing FK targets/history.

invariants.rule: Direct SR↔RFC relationships target only root/master RFCs; subordinate RFCs receive SR context only through hierarchy inheritance.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Reject direct subordinate link and verify inherited context/provenance.

invariants.rule: RFC hierarchy is an acyclic one-parent forest with at most two levels; a subordinate can never parent another RFC.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Self-cycle, indirect cycle, second parent and depth-three attempts fail atomically.

invariants.rule: Root/Master/Subordinate/standalone RFC roles are derived from relationships; no independent mutable role flag is authoritative.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Reparent/add/remove child recomputes roles without role-field reconciliation.

invariants.rule: No arbitrary business child-count cap limits a valid RFC branch; scale is a UI/query/technical concern.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Branches larger than twenty valid children remain representable/queryable.

invariants.rule: Resolved RFC branch members share one canonical Customer Organization; unresolved ownership stays explicit and Infrastructure does not establish RFC Customer authority.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Known mismatch blocks hierarchy mutation, unknown warns, Infrastructure-only evidence does not assign Customer.

invariants.rule: SR↔RFC link/unlink is lifecycle-neutral and history-preserving; duplicate link/already-absent unlink is idempotent.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Link/unlink terminal and active tickets without reopen/restart/cascade effects.

invariants.rule: An RFC may own zero-to-many Device Reference contexts directly, including without an SR and with subordinate-specific differences.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Standalone/subordinate RFC device scenarios persist independently of SR relationship.

invariants.rule: RFC/SR operational device relationships always target Device Reference; regularization to Network Element never replaces those relationship identities.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Promote/reconcile Device Reference and verify all ticket links retain the same Device Reference FK/identity.

invariants.rule: Accepted terminal RFC evidence and execution of the local terminal cascade are separate authoritative operations.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Accept terminal evidence and verify no Task/Objective/Communication consequence before explicit cascade confirmation.

invariants.rule: RFC archival is reversible SOMA-local presentation state and does not stop exact-identity source reconciliation.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Import newer exact RFC evidence while archived and surface reviewed restore/conflict behavior without identity change.

invariants.rule: Hard deletion is limited to a provably untouched manual draft; imported/adopted/related/WFM/history-bearing RFCs remain history-preserved.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Deletion eligibility vectors cover provenance, relationships, WFM history, audit and lifecycle evidence.

invariants.rule: Working Notes are SOMA-owned and source import never overwrites or deletes them.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Import changed source fields around existing notes and verify note identity/history remains intact.

invariants.rule: WFM ownership of one RFC does not create a WFM hierarchy; WFM master/subordinate context is derived only from the owning RFC hierarchy.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Reparent RFC and verify current WFM context recomputes without creating/changing WFM identity or hierarchy fields.
